## Scope check

This repository only accepts publishable knowledge — methodology, standards, runnable
reference implementations, templates. Confirm your proposal contains no customer
names, real personal names, internal project codenames, credentials, internal business
strategy, unpublished IP, or operational data.

- [ ] My proposal stays inside that boundary (see [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/onewonderjapan/ow-open-knowledge/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md))

## Language

Documents keep their original language — Japanese documents are edited in Japanese,
Chinese documents in Chinese. Translation-style rewrites are out of scope.

- [ ] This proposal keeps the affected documents in their existing language
